title: DashPack
description: I have lately been working to change every game texture.  I call it the "Dash Pack!"  Enjoy!
body: I have been working on overhauling all Minecraft textures.  I have almost all music disks done but I am still missing a few.  I believe this to work in versions before 1.21.8 however I am not positive as of right now.  To turn it on in the game, press esc, next click options, then find Resource Packs, upload a file, I reccomend extracting the zip, then putting it in.  I do however know that it does infact work in 1.21.8+.
